#Module ext

On this page

  • Functions
  • Ext_info
  • Ext_manifest
  • Ext_message
  • Ext_call
  • Ext_listen
  • Ext_take
  • Ext_respond
  • Ext_connect
  • Ext_portPost
  • Ext_portClose

The transport of browser extensions (docs/extensions.md, section 3.9; src/page/ext_realm.odin, ext_router.odin; native/js/odin/ext_runtime.odin and ext_api.js build chrome.* on it). The host derives the extension and the kind of context from the realm that calls (a guest sends no identity): in a realm that is not an extension context every function answers nothing ("" , a rejected call, no effect). Payloads are JSON text, as Chrome's messages are, and are bounded by extensions.message.max_bytes.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/ext.widl.

Odin: import "wren:ext".

#Functions

#Ext_info

string Ext_info()

The realm's context as a JSON object ("" : not an extension context): id, kind (background, popup, tab), base URL, UI language, platform, and the API methods and events this context may use (its permissions decide them).

Odin: ext.info.

Host: Ext_info :: proc(c: ^Call) -> string

#Ext_manifest

string Ext_manifest()

runtime.getManifest(): the manifest as JSON text, comments removed and MSG_* replaced.

Odin: ext.manifest.

Host: Ext_manifest :: proc(c: ^Call) -> string

#Ext_message

string Ext_message(string name, string subs)

i18n.getMessage(name, substitutions): subs is a JSON list of strings. "" when no catalogue has the message.

Odin: ext.message.

Host: Ext_message :: proc(c: ^Call, name: string, subs: string) -> string

#Ext_call

Promise Ext_call(string method, string args)

An API call (method as "storage.local.get", args a JSON list): a promise of the answer as text: a JSON value, "" for undefined, or "!" followed by the error's message (runtime.lastError).

Odin: ext.call.

Host: Ext_call :: proc(c: ^Call, method: string, args: string) -> u64

#Ext_listen

void Ext_listen(string event, bool on)

The realm added a listener of event ("runtime.onMessage"), or removed its last one (on false): an event nobody listens to is not sent, and a stopped background does not start for it.

Odin: ext.listen.

Host: Ext_listen :: proc(c: ^Call, event: string, on: bool)

#Ext_take

string Ext_take()

The next event for this realm as a JSON object ("" : none waits): {t: "event", e, a, r}, {t: "connect", p, n, s}, {t: "port", p, m}, {t: "disconnect", p}. The host calls the realm's wj_ext_event when one arrives.

Odin: ext.take.

Host: Ext_take :: proc(c: ^Call) -> string

#Ext_respond

void Ext_respond(u64 reply, string value, bool has)

The answer of this realm to message reply (runtime.onMessage): has false when its listeners gave none.

Odin: ext.respond.

Host: Ext_respond :: proc(c: ^Call, reply: u64, value: string, has: bool)

#Ext_connect

void Ext_connect(u64 port, string name)

runtime.connect: a port this realm opens, id port (its own choice), named name, to the other contexts of its extension that listen to runtime.onConnect.

Odin: ext.connect.

Host: Ext_connect :: proc(c: ^Call, port: u64, name: string)

#Ext_portPost

void Ext_portPost(u64 port, string message)

Port.postMessage: message (JSON text) to the other end(s) of port.

Odin: ext.portPost.

Host: Ext_portPost :: proc(c: ^Call, port: u64, message: string)

#Ext_portClose

void Ext_portClose(u64 port)

Port.disconnect: the other end(s) get onDisconnect.

Odin: ext.portClose.

Host: Ext_portClose :: proc(c: ^Call, port: u64)
